---
description: Write the tables within some relationships of one or more centers, as a DBML slice.
title: ichnos neighborhood
---

`ichnos neighborhood` writes the tables within `--depth` relationships of one or more center tables, as a DBML slice.
ichnos cuts the slice to fit `--budget`, down to its core, the centers.

## Usage

```{python}
#| label: help
#| echo: false
from _scripts.example import ichnos

ichnos("neighborhood", "--help")
```

## Example

```{python}
#| label: example
#| echo: false
from _scripts.example import ichnos

ichnos("neighborhood", "queries", "SALES.ORDERS", "--budget", "2500")
```
